output_schema.title: Closed independent assessor packet
output_schema.description: Integrity-only prototype schema. Exact task, arm, facet, pool-source, delivery, frozen claim, and assessor assignment membership is checked against the separately frozen registry by validate.py.txt. Source and answer packets are separate; the validator never joins assessors or computes semantic truth. Quote/hash/offset fields are deterministic integrity envelopes for a future frozen hydrator, not fields a model must reproduce; this prototype does not implement that hydrator.
